title: Dive into Deep Learning
author: Aston Zhang, Zachary C. Lipton, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
description: An interactive deep learning textbook combining explanations, mathematics, and runnable code (PyTorch, NumPy, JAX, and TensorFlow). Covers linear and softmax regression, MLPs, CNNs, RNNs, attention and transformers, and more. Adopted at 500+ universities.
